mechanics.summary: Close combat uses CLOSE COMBAT, occurs in the same hex, and requires no barrier between attacker and target.

outcome.value: cannot attack across barrier in close combat

exceptions: Cover has no effect against close combat attacks.

mechanics.summary: A successful close-combat attack inflicts weapon base damage plus 1 damage per extra success.

outcome.value: base damage plus one per success beyond first

mechanics.summary: A close-combat attack inflicts a critical injury when damage after armor and cover is at least the weapon crit threshold.

outcome.value: roll critical injury for hit location when threshold met

mechanics.summary: When pushing a close-combat roll, each bane reduces weapon reliability by 1; if unarmed, each bane inflicts 1 damage on the attacker.

outcome.value: -1 reliability per bane, or 1 self-damage per bane unarmed

exceptions: A weapon that breaks does so after the attack resolves.

mechanics.summary: A prone attacker has -2 to close-combat attacks.
trigger: prone combatant attacks in close combat
exceptions: Hits are automatically on the legs of a standing opponent.

mechanics.summary: A prone attacker's hit against a standing opponent automatically strikes the legs.
trigger: prone attacker hits standing opponent in close combat

outcome.value: hit location legs

mechanics.summary: A close-combat attack against a prone target has +2.
A close-combat attack against a defenseless or unaware target has +3.
trigger: close-combat attack targets defenseless or unaware combatant
exceptions: The bonus is not increased when the target is prone.

unknowns: Defenseless and awareness state require input.

mechanics.summary: An aimed blow can choose head, torso, legs, or arms as hit location and has -2.
A target can spend a fast action to declare a CLOSE COMBAT block before the strike roll; each block success removes one attacker success.
trigger: target declares close-combat block before attack roll

outcome.value: remove one attack success per block success

exceptions: Excess block successes have no effect.

mechanics.summary: A block is not an opposed roll and may be pushed after the attacker has declared and performed any push.
trigger: block roll fails or is pushed

outcome.value: push block roll

unknowns: Roll and declaration history is required.

mechanics.summary: Each block consumes one of the blocker’s two actions for the round; after two blocks no further blocks are possible that round.

outcome.value: spend one available action; maximum two blocks if no other actions spent

exceptions: Blocking breaks turn order.
Actions refresh each round and unused actions cannot be saved.

mechanics.summary: A combatant who runs into an enemy’s hex and then makes an unarmed attack in the same round gets +2.
trigger: run into enemy hex then unarmed attack in same round
exceptions: Diving blows can be blocked.

mechanics.summary: On a successful diving blow, damage resolves normally and both attacker and target become prone.

outcome.value: both combatants prone

mechanics.summary: On a failed diving blow, only the attacker becomes prone.

outcome.value: attacker prone

mechanics.summary: A fast CLOSE COMBAT shove succeeds with one success, or two if the opponent has higher STR.
exceptions: The shove causes no damage and excess successes have no effect.
The opponent can block.

mechanics.summary: A successful shove makes the opponent fall prone.

outcome.value: target prone

mechanics.summary: A fast CLOSE COMBAT disarm needs one success for a one-handed item or two successes for a two-handed item.
exceptions: The action causes no damage and excess successes have no effect.
The opponent can block.

mechanics.summary: A successful disarm makes the opponent drop the item in the same hex.

outcome.value: item dropped in target hex

mechanics.summary: A slow unarmed CLOSE COMBAT grapple can be blocked; on success both combatants fall prone, the opponent drops held weapons, and cannot move.

outcome.value: both prone; target drops weapons and cannot move

unknowns: Grappled state and held weapons need state tracking.

mechanics.summary: A grappled opponent can only attempt a slow break-free action, requiring an opposed CLOSE COMBAT win; the grappler can only make a fast, unarmed grapple attack that cannot be blocked.

outcome.value: restrict actions to printed grapple actions

mechanics.summary: A combatant leaving a hex with an active enemy and no barrier must roll MOBILITY; failure still moves them but gives the enemy an immediate free close-combat attack that cannot be blocked.
trigger: combatant retreats from same-hex active enemy without barrier

outcome.value: on failure, enemy gets free unblockable close-combat attack

exceptions: The enemy attack is out of turn and does not spend an action.

mechanics.summary: For same-hex enemy NPC group close-combat attacks, one NPC rolls and each other helper adds +1, to a maximum +3.

outcome.value: +1 per helper, maximum +3

mechanics.summary: For a human hit by ranged, close-combat, or explosion damage, roll D6: 1 legs, 2-4 torso, 5 arm, 6 head.
exceptions: Called shots and aimed blows choose hit location.
Do not roll hit location for damage from pushing.

mechanics.summary: Use only the most effective body-armor layer; body armor combines with cover or vehicle armor by adding armor levels.
trigger: hit location has armor or cover

outcome.value: highest body armor plus applicable cover or vehicle armor

mechanics.summary: Apply a weapon armor modifier to armor level before determining penetration, unless the target has no armor.

outcome.value: modified armor level

exceptions: Do not apply armor modifier if target has no armor.

mechanics.summary: Reduce damage by modified armor level; zero damage means the hit is fully deflected but still triggers a CUF roll.

outcome.value: damage minus modified armor; zero is fully deflected

mechanics.summary: An attack is fully deflected if weapon base damage is at least two steps lower than modified armor, regardless of rolled successes or ammo-die symbols.

outcome.value: damage fully deflected

mechanics.summary: After armor or cover is penetrated, roll D6; on 1 its armor level decreases one step, and at zero it provides no protection.
Damage equal to or above hit capacity causes incapacitation: the character can only crawl and mumble, cannot perform other actions, and cannot roll skills.

outcome.value: incapacitated by damage

mechanics.summary: To kill an incapacitated human outright, fail an EMP attribute-only roll; success means the killer cannot do it, while a failed roll causes 1 stress.
trigger: combatant attempts to kill incapacitated human

outcome.value: failed EMP kills target and inflicts 1 stress

exceptions: Killer specialty permits killing defenseless enemies without these negative effects.

unknowns: Intent and target humanity require input.

mechanics.summary: Damage after armor and cover at or above weapon crit threshold inflicts a critical injury; roll D10 on the struck location’s table.

outcome.value: critical injury by location

mechanics.summary: Every arm critical makes the target drop held items; every leg critical makes the target fall down.
If damage exceeds crit threshold by at least 2, roll two D10 and use highest; for each additional two steps, roll one further D10 and use highest.

outcome.value: D10 count increases by one per two steps above threshold; use highest

mechanics.summary: At a lethal critical injury’s listed limit, make a STAMINA death save; failure kills, success requires another save after the same interval.
trigger: lethal critical injury time limit expires

outcome.value: failed save causes death; successful save repeats at interval

exceptions: Round-limit save is on next turn.
Incapacitated target cannot push; otherwise may push.
Death save is not an action.

mechanics.summary: A character moving with a lethal critical injury makes an immediate death save; a mover of that character rolls MEDICAL AID, and failure causes an immediate death save.
trigger: wounded character with lethal critical injury moves

outcome.value: immediate death save on printed conditions

exceptions: A carrier’s running action moves only one hex plus one per Mobility success.

mechanics.summary: A successful MEDICAL AID roll takes the crit’s time limit and increases it one category; successful treatment at shift limit ends death saves.
trigger: medical aid treats lethal critical injury

outcome.value: round to stretch, stretch to shift, or end death-save risk at shift

exceptions: Self-treatment while not incapacitated has -2.
On failure, retry only after a death save.

value.1: Dislocated shoulder; Ranged Combat -2 with two-handed weapons; D6 days
value.2: Slashed forearm; Ranged Combat -2 with two-handed weapons; 2D6 days
value.3: Crushed fingers; Ranged Combat -2 with two-handed weapons; 3D6 days

value.5: Broken forearm; two-handed weapons cannot be used; 2D6 days

value.8: Shattered elbow; lethal shift; two-handed weapons cannot be used; 3D6 days
value.9: Arterial bleeding; lethal stretch; Ranged Combat -2 with two-handed weapons; 2D6 days
value.10: Severed arm; lethal stretch; two-handed weapons cannot be used; permanent

mechanics.summary: Skill modifiers from multiple critical injuries are cumulative; other effects are not.

outcome.value: sum skill modifiers only

exceptions: Multiple arm crits do not remove use of one-handed weapons.

mechanics.summary: Immediately make a CUF roll when hit by enemy fire, even if armor or cover fully deflects damage, or when a failed attack’s ammo dice show one or more ammo successes.
trigger: eligible enemy-fire hit or failed eligible attack ammo result

outcome.value: make CUF roll

exceptions: Only firearms, heavy weapons, and explosions trigger suppression; close combat, bows, and thrown weapons do not.

mechanics.summary: A CUF roll uses one base die for current CUF and also one for current unit morale if the combatant has line of sight to a non-incapacitated friendly fighter.
inputs: line of sight to non-incapacitated friendly

outcome.value: one CUF base die plus conditional unit-morale base die

exceptions: CUF rolls are not actions and cannot be pushed.

mechanics.summary: Failed CUF causes immediate prone, 1 stress, and suppression until the next turn’s CUF resolution.
On the next turn, a suppressed combatant makes CUF again: failure loses both actions; success keeps slow action but loses fast action; suppression then ends either way.

value.success: lose fast action and retain slow action

mechanics.summary: When a combatant fails CUF and is suppressed, all friendly fighters in the same hex immediately make CUF rolls to avoid suppression.

outcome.value: each friendly makes CUF roll

mechanics.summary: A target fully inside a vehicle cannot be suppressed.

outcome.value: suppression unavailable

exceptions: Such occupants can be forced to bail out by separate vehicle rules.

mechanics.summary: For a stressful situation, roll CUF; each success removes 1 potential stress, and any stress suffered freezes the combatant and removes both actions on next turn.
trigger: Referee assigns 1-3 potential stress from stressful event

outcome.value: potential stress minus CUF successes; if remaining stress at least 1, lose both next-turn actions

exceptions: CUF rolls cannot be pushed.

mechanics.summary: Stress at or above stress capacity causes stress incapacitation: the character can run for cover but cannot take other actions or roll skills.

outcome.value: incapacitated by stress

mechanics.summary: The combat stressful-situations table assigns potential stress 1 for direct ranged hit/successful suppression or witnessing buddy damage/PC lethal crit; 2 for witnessing buddy lethal crit; 3 for witnessing massacre or torture.

unknowns: Witnessing and buddy relationship require input.
